about.title: Ibitwerekeye Skyline Motors
about.subtitle: Kuduga mu ntera mu kwigendesha i Bujumbura mu Burundi.
about.missionDesc: Kuri Skyline Motors, intumbero yacu ni uguhindura ingene abantu banyongera mu Burundi mukubaha imiduga myiza cane ikoresha umuyagankuba. Twaritayeho gutanga ibikorwa vy'akataraboneka, inyishu zirama hamwe n'uburigene bworoshe bwo kwitunga umuduga, kugira abakiliya bacu barihe make kandi banyonge neza cane. Turateye ishema ryo kuzana kazoza k'ukugendesha imiduga i Bujumbura.
about.leadershipDesc: Abatunganya neza imigambi ifise intumbero inyuma y'urugendo rw'imiduga rukomeye mu Burundi.
about.premiumServiceDesc: Gufatwa neza mu nzego zose, kuva mu biganiro gushika ku kwitwararika no gukurikirana mu gihugu cose.
about.sustainableSolutionsDesc: Kuyobora urugendo rwo kwimukira ku mbaraga z'icyatsi mu Burundi utitaye ku bihano canke ku bwiza bw'umuduga.
about.seamlessOwnershipDesc: Uburyo bwo kworohereza mu mahera, amasezerano yo kwizerera yo mu rwego rwo hejuru, n'ibidukikije byoroshye ku banyongaji b'akataraboneka.

services.heroDesc: Raba ingene réseau yacu yo guchaji yihuta cane iriko iraguka kurenza urugero mu Burundi no muri Repebuli ya Demokarasi ya Kongo.
services.gridDesc: Ibibanza biteguye neza bihuza Bujumbura gushika ku mbibi za Kinshasa na Goma. Réseau yacu niyo nkingi y'ingendo z'amashanyarazi muri Afrika.
services.thirtyMinsDesc: Guchaji mu minota mike cyane kuva kuri 20% gushika kuri 80% y'inguvu.
services.secDesc: Ibibanza birinzwe neza bifise n'ibibanza vyiza vyo kuruhukiramo.
services.homeSuiteDesc: Inyishu z'inguvu nziza ku rugo rwawe canke ku biro vy'uburongozi.
services.precisionManufDesc: Abasuzumyi bacu bafise impapuro z'umutsindo bakoresha ibikoresho vyihariye mu kumenya ingene bateri ihagaze no gutunganya neza igipimo c'ubushuhe ku bera ikirere co mu rurembo rwa Afrika yo hagati.
services.coverageDesc: Igarantiya y'imyaka 8 canke ibirometero 160,000 ku bikoresho vyose vy'umuduga, backed by ubufasha bw'imbere mu gihugu mu Burundi na DRC.
services.certifiedTechsDesc: Ukwigishwa kudasiba gufasha abakozi bacu kuguma imbere mu buhanga bw'imiduga y'amashanyarazi n'amategeko y'umutekano.
services.supportDesc: Ufise ibibazo ku gushiraho canke uko réseau ihagaze? Hamagara abatunganya ibikorwa bacu mu karere biciye kuri WhatsApp.
services.waBtn: Tunga Ibiganiro n'Abasuzumyi ku bwo Guchaji biciye kuri WhatsApp

contact.helpDesc: Injira mu rugendo rwa kazoza k'ukugendesha mu Burundi no muri DRC. Abasuzumyi bacu biteguye kukorohereza kwinjira mu rugendo rwa kazoza k'amashanyarazi.
contact.testimonial: Skyline yaragabanyije iminsi yo gutegura imigambi ku gipimo ca 30% kandi yahinduye urugendo gwacu mu karere k'u Burundi na DRC biciye mu gufasha imiduga y'amashanyarazi (EV).
contact.kinshasaHub: Ikibanza co Gutwariramu Ibintu ca Kinshasa
contact.supportSubtitle: Bihari amasaha yose 24/7 ku bwo gufasha ibikoresho vy'amashanyarazi mu karere.
contact.consent: Ndemeye ko amakuru yanje akoreshwa twisunze amategeko yo kurinda umutekano w'amakuru.
